Programa autónomo y de control manual de: Autonomous and manual control program for the Robotica76 robot, MakeX 2026 "StormBreaker" challenge.
Se ejecuta en el controlador NovaPi de m: Runs on the mBuild NovaPi controller with a 4-wheel mecanum chassis (encoder motors M1-M4), an AI camera that reads QR/tags, a gripper (DC1 moves it, DC2 opens/closes it) and a launcher with two brushless motors (BL1/BL2). Operation: - On boot it waits 30 s, initializes the camera tag recognition and enters main(). - main() is a gamepad control loop: the joysticks always drive the chassis and the buttons trigger actions: N1 = 28 s autonomous routine (reads tags and moves accordingly), N2 = stop motors, Up/Down = move gripper, L1/R1 = open/close gripper, N3 = launcher (R2/L2 adjust power, N3 stops it).

Aplica las velocidades globales v1..v4 a: Applies the global wheel speeds v1..v4 to the motors (M2 and M4 are inverted because of their mounting direction).
Rutina autónoma de decisión basada en lo: Autonomous decision routine based on the tags seen by the AI camera.
Lee el tag izquierdo (id 2) y el derecho: Reads the left (id 2) and right (id 3) tags. If neither is found it assumes two cones and moves forward. If both tags are at the same position it either grabs the cube (tag value 2) or moves, re-reads the tag and compares both readings. Otherwise it compares the two tags directly. The result is delegated to Comparacion_Valores() and Mov_Auto().

Mueve el robot de forma autónoma durante: Moves the robot autonomously for a fixed time.

Atiende el inicio autónomo (N1, 28 s), p: Handles the autonomous start (N1, 28 s), motor stop (N2), gripper (Up/Down, L1/R1) and launcher (N3), and continuously drives the chassis with the joysticks.
